Shape a brighter financial future with us.
Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.
We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

You are a curious creator who isn’t afraid to step boldly into the future. You don't just adapt to new technologies—you run toward them, eager to experiment with generative AI workflows and wield them to shape the living visual narrative of a brand.
The Creative Studio at SoFi is looking for a visionary Staff Photographer to join our best-in-class, in-house creative agency. In this role, you won’t just be producing static marketing images; you will be co-creating an evocative visual universe that defines what financial freedom actually feels like.
At SoFi, we hold a deep, foundational respect for the traditional craft of photography—the magic of pristine composition, real human emotion, and impeccable lighting–while also actively challenging ourselves to scale our brand’s visual output to unprecedented heights. We believe the future lies at the intersection of heritage and innovation.

By blending the soul of high-end, fashion-forward commercial photography with advanced generative AI, you will help us develop high-quality, deeply artistic imagery and video across all of SoFi’s marketing and communication platforms.
This isn't a one-dimensional studio gig. You will master a distinct, multi-tiered visual ecosystem that requires you to flex both your technical precision and your wildest creative metaphors:
The Foundational: Executing crisp, macro, trust-building product shots that ground our members in clarity and security.
The Surreal: Crafting fashionable, high-concept visual metaphors that beautifully externalize the pure triumph of achieving financial independence.
Ultimately, your creative inspiration and skill capturing photography and video, flawless image retouching, and emerging AI tools will serve as the bedrock for this new frontier of image creation. If you are ready to honor the traditional lens while pioneering the digital one, we want to build the future of fintech imagery with you.
This is a full time contract position through 2026, with the potential to continue into 2027.

Collaborate closely with Art Directors, Brand Strategists, and Copywriters to conceptualize, plan, and execute studio and location photo and video shoots for our visual library
Master and capture a distinct multi-tiered visual ecosystem in order to capture the core theme of our hero moments.
Possess the skills and vision required to execute crisp product shots, dynamic full-body on-the-move tracking shots, dramatic low-angle power posture shots for every model bracket, and trust-building product shots that ground our members' financial journeys.
Concept and capture high-leverage, surreal visual metaphors that vividly externalize the psychological triumph of getting your money right.
Approach lighting, plate photography, composition, and subjects with an "AI-first" mindset, capturing assets specifically optimized for downstream AI manipulation and generation.
Partner with our post-production, motion and vfx teams to guide raw imagery through CG and AI tools to deliver seamless "SoFi" assets.
Operate advanced DSLR, mirrorless camera technology, and mid-level cinema and studio lighting setups.
Retouch photos and video with traditional retouching tools as well as AI tools like Runway and Adobe custom models.
Champion the SoFi brand narrative, ensuring all imagery evokes the emotion, forward-thinking energy, and financial confidence of our community.
What You’ll Need
A minimum of 4+ years working as a commercial photographer at an ad agency, in-house creative department, or freelancing for major consumer brands.
A strong, well-rounded portfolio and reel showcasing beautiful, functional work that demonstrates an elite grasp of color, composition, typography, and lighting
Comfortable shooting both in studio or on location
A deep, active curiosity about AI and an eager interest in the application of Generative AI software within creative workflows.
Technical knowledge of using gen AI models (e.g., Runway, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly) for adding effects like textures and lighting to photographic plates
Technical knowledge of motion capture and understanding of compositing imagery and video for video clips (shooting video clips to be used in for this purpose)
Technical understanding of file size and type requirements for delivery to multiple platforms
Self-motivated and able to work independently on set while also supporting the larger creative studio team
Experience working in a hybrid remote/office capacity as required by production schedules.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple project timelines.
A collaborative spirit and the ability to remain "ego-less" when receiving creative feedback.
Clear communication skills to articulate editorial choices to non-technical stakeholders.

Experience working in similar regulated, fast-paced tech industries
Proficiency in design and post-production software including Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) and Figma.
Production experience with social media trends and creating content optimized for platforms like TikTok.

Experience
3+ years of relevant experience in high-end real estate or architectural photography editing, specifically thriving within a high-volume, fast-paced environment.
Proven track record of handling complex photo manipulation and efficiently satisfying direct client revision requests.
Skills
Visual Eye: An exceptional eye for detail, composition, and color accuracy, with a firm understanding of ethical guidelines in real estate editing to avoid misrepresenting properties.
Technical Mastery & Specialized Edits: Expert Adobe proficiency with deep knowledge of advanced real estate (window pulls, object removal, sky replacements, virtual twilights) and portrait editing (skin retouching, clothing fixes, background cleanups).
Communication: Highly proficient in English (written and verbal) to collaborate effectively with our US-based team.
Real Estate Photo Editing & Retouching
Efficiently process a high volume of images daily while maintaining our strict quality and aesthetic standards.
Execute complex edit requests on delivered imagery and end to end processing (from HDR merge to complete). Edit and polish professional headshots style portraits.
Maintain a highly flexible aesthetic approach that can seamlessly match our delivered guidance and satisfy specific client preferences.
Quality Alignment & Workflow
Partner directly with the QA/QC team to address and resolve flagged edits on published photos, ensuring strict adherence to internal style guidelines.
Proactively contribute to process, workflow, and stylistic improvements across the post-production pipeline. Escalate highly complex issues or recurring quality trends to leadership as needed.
Create or alter actions, workflows or scripts that optimize repeatable tasks.
AI & Process Efficiency: Experience leveraging AI technology within Adobe products and modern real estate AI platforms (e.g., AutoHDR, Imagen, Autoenhance), as well as Actions, Workflows, or scripting to speed up complex, repeatable tasks a plus.
Portrait Retouching Experience with headshot-style portraits (including advanced skin retouching, clothing fixing, stray hair removal, etc.) is a big plus.
Employment Type: Full-Time | Remote

Production & Editing: Works under the Marketing Director to create/modify digital images, graphics, and storyboards. Digitizes, edits, and mixes audio, video, and visual recordings (incorporating special effects, animation, and music libraries). Prepares raw footage into polished products that meet industry standards.
Who May Apply: Open to everyone. Applicants will be categorized by preference(s) and/or priority consideration eligibilities.

An applicant's eligibility will be determined based on eligibility claimed in the questionnaire and proof of eligibility MUST be provided with application by the closing date, 08/14/2026 Business Based Action, Military Spouse Preference, Outside Applicant Veteran, Spouse/Widow/Parent of Veteran, and Transition Hiring Preference In order to qualify, you must meet the experience requirements described below.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student; social). You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Your resume must clearly describe your relevant experience; if the position allows for qualifying based on education, your transcripts will be required as part of your application. Qualifying Experience: Technical Operations: Operates standard photography and motion picture equipment.

Configures peripheral lighting, sounds equipment, and determines optimal camera angles/shot sequencing. - Identifies and prepares script breakdowns, shot lists, and special effects. Coordination & Compliance: Reviews/edits photos, scripts, and media to ensure alignment with FSS communication themes, protocols, and policies.

Research subject matter and arranges specialized equipment for unique assignments. Field Support: Attends community events and programs to provide active media coverage. Authorized to operate government vehicles (e.g., light trucks, sedans, golf carts) to support transport and field operations.

Core Experience: Progressively responsible professional photography and videography experience. Portfolio Requirement: Must provide a portfolio showcasing a diverse collection of well-executed photos and videos.

Software Proficiency: Demonstrated experience using Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Lightroom, etc.) or other professional editing software. Equipment Operation: Hands-on experience operating a variety of cameras and related video equipment.

Bist du bereit, deine Leidenschaft für Fotografie mit der Welt des Automobils zu verbinden? Bei netconnection GmbH suchen wir einen engagierten Außendienst Automobil-Fotografen (m/w/d), der unser Team verstärkt. Seit über 25 Jahren sind wir ein führender Datendienstleister im Automobilhandel und verbinden Autohäuser mit digitalen Marktplätzen.

Deine Aufgabe wird es sein, Fahrzeuge in Szene zu setzen und so unseren Kunden zu helfen, ihre Bestände optimal zu präsentieren. Du wirst Teil unserer Mission, den Automobilvertrieb voll digital zu gestalten und nachhaltigen Erfolg zu sichern. Wenn du aufgeschlossen bist, gerne unterwegs bist und Autos liebst, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Aufgaben
Dein Aufgabengebiet umfasst die Fotografie von Fahrzeugen gemäß unseren Leitlinien sowie die anschließende digitale Nachbearbeitung der Bilder. Die Aufträge sowie die Kunden werden von uns bereitgestellt, sodass du dich voll und ganz auf das Fotografieren konzentrieren kannst – wir übernehmen die gesamte logistische Planung für dich!
Qualifikation
Interesse für Fahrzeuge aller Marken
Erfahrung und/oder Passion für Fotografie
Kontaktfreudigkeit
Lernbereitschaft
Führerschein Klasse B
Zuverlässigkeit und Flexibilität

Flexible Arbeitszeiten
Weiterbildung
Skalierbare Verdienstmöglichkeiten/Provisionierung
Nach unserem umfassenden digitalen Onboarding-Prozess bist du in der Regel innerhalb einer Woche bereit, deine ersten Aufträge zu übernehmen und durchzustarten. Dabei stehen wir dir jederzeit mit Rat und Tat zur Seite, um sicherzustellen, dass du bestens vorbereitet und sicher in deine neue Aufgabe starten kannst.

About The Role Photographers are the eyes of the publication and we're looking for photographers who want to create the most iconic images of our era. We want photographers who's work that sit somewhere between documentation and fantasy. Your work should feel surreal, cinematic, raw, and unforced, and whether you shoot film or digital, in the studio or on the street, we want photographers who prioritize grit, mood, and instinct over commercial perfection. Responsibilities
Cover nightlife, gallery openings, and cultural moments. We need editorial documentation, not commercial event recaps.
Translate creative direction and mood boards into final image sets that fit the publication’s aesthetic without losing your personal style.
Take charge of the environment and manage talent on set or on location to get the shot. You must be comfortable directing people, not just observing them.
Manage your own post-production to deliver high-resolution, editorial-grade files on deadline.

2+ years of professional experience in photography (editorial, portrait, or documentary).
You must have experience shooting portraits and human subjects. We are not looking for landscape or still-life specialists for this role.
Expert knowledge of manual camera settings, on-set lighting, and flash photography.
Proficient in Adobe Lightroom, Capture One, or Photoshop.
Your work has a defined style. We are not looking for standard commercial, bridal, or corporate event photography.
Compensation & Rates This is a contributor-based role focused on editorial storytelling.
Editorial Stipends: We provide stipends for commissioned features and event coverage ($50–$100 USD per project depending on scope).
Expenses Covered: We cover entry fees, tickets, and production costs for assigned events and shoots.
Portfolio Growth: This role is designed for photographers looking to build a curated editorial portfolio with full creative credit and global visibility. Priority consideration is offered for future editorials and paid commissions as opportunities open.
